# SBC US LLC

> SBC US LLC (SBC USA, SBC US, SBCLLC US, SBCLLC USA) provides tax, finance and compliance for businesses across the United States, India and the UAE. Slogan: Local connect. Global outlook.

SBC US LLC is the firm at https://www.sbcusllc.com. The same practice is searched as SBC USA, SBC US, SBCLLC US, SBCLLC USA and SBC LLC USA. It is an independent member firm of Kreston. 270+ professionals serve 350+ multinational clients. The firm handles 88 global applicable compliances for groups with US and India operations.

## Services

- [US tax services](https://www.sbcusllc.com/services/us-tax-services): Entity, tax and filings for groups with US and India operations, including federal and state returns.
- [Transfer pricing](https://www.sbcusllc.com/services/transfer-pricing): US transfer pricing policy, documentation and benchmarking.
- [US CPA outsourcing](https://www.sbcusllc.com/services/us-cpa-outsourcing): An India team that works to a US CPA firm's standards.
- [Bookkeeping and FP&A](https://www.sbcusllc.com/services/bookkeeping-fpa): From clean books to board-ready numbers, plus audit support.
- [GCC India setup](https://www.sbcusllc.com/services/gcc-india-setup): Workspace, talent, entity and finance for an India GCC, end to end.
- [Business restructuring](https://www.sbcusllc.com/services/business-restructuring): Corporate restructuring and entity rationalization for US companies.
